bib.title: Reasoning on Graphs: Faithful and Interpretable Large Language Model Reasoning

read.skipped: Reference list skimmed only for lineage.

question: How can an LLM reason faithfully over a knowledge graph, using its structure and not only its triples, for KGQA?
hypothesis: Relation paths grounded in the KG make faithful plans: executing them retrieves valid reasoning paths, and training an LLM on both planning and reasoning beats treating the KG as a flat fact store.
contributions: A planning-retrieval-reasoning framework (RoG) in which the LLM generates KG-grounded relation paths as plans, they are executed on the KG, and the LLM reasons over the retrieved paths.
Two instruction-tuning tasks (planning optimization, retrieval-reasoning optimization) derived from an ELBO, that distil KG knowledge into the LLM.
The planning module plugs into other LLMs at inference without retraining.
State-of-the-art results on WebQSP and CWQ with interpretable explanations.

method.summary: LLaMA2-Chat-7B is instruction-tuned jointly on a planning task (generate shortest relation paths between question and answer entities) and a retrieval-reasoning task (answer from retrieved paths). At inference it beam-searches top-3 relation paths, a constrained BFS retrieves reasoning paths from Freebase, and the same LLM answers with an explanation.

datasets.name: WebQSP
datasets.split: standard train/test splits as in prior work
datasets.preprocessing: Freebase subgraph of triples within max reasoning hops of question entities; question and answer entities assumed labelled and linked to the KG

datasets.name: CWQ
datasets.split: standard train/test splits as in prior work

datasets.name: Freebase subgraph
datasets.size: 2,566,291 entities, 7,058 relations, 8,309,195 triples (full Freebase: ~88M entities, 20K relations, 126M triples)

datasets.name: MetaQA-3hop (Wiki-Movies KG)
datasets.size: 1,000 train samples used / 1,4274 test (as printed) (printed '1,4274'); KG 43,234 entities, 9 relations, 133,582 triples

datasets.name: Instruction-tuning data
datasets.source: built from WebQSP and CWQ training splits
datasets.preprocessing: shortest paths between question and answer entities as planning supervision; 1000 samples per dataset passed to ChatGPT to produce explanations

models.name: RoG (LLaMA2-Chat-7B backbone)
models.tokenizer: LLaMA2; relation names split into tokens, special tokens <PATH>, <SEP>, </PATH>

other.version: model released between July and Sept 2023

training.objective: L = log P(a|q,Z*_K,G) + (1/|Z*|) sum log P(z|q): retrieval-reasoning plus planning (shortest-path relation paths), one LLM trained jointly (Eq. 7)
training.wall_clock: 38 hours (Freebase); 2 hours to transfer to Wiki-Movies

other.joint_training: fine-tuned jointly on WebQSP and CWQ training splits plus Freebase

inference.decoding: beam search for top-K relation paths; constrained BFS retrieval; all retrieved paths fed to the reasoner
inference.samples: not stated; single run per table cell
inference.prompting: RoG uses fine-tuned planning/reasoning/explanation templates; LLM baselines are zero-shot; the explanation prompt uses few-shot human-annotated examples
inference.retrieval: K = 3 relation paths; constrained BFS from question entities following the relation path (Algorithm 1)

results.table: Table 1, row RoG, column WebQSP F1 (70.8); DECAF 78.8

limits: Question and answer entities are assumed labelled and linked to the KG (Sec 3); no entity linking is evaluated.
Planner is fine-tuned per KG (38 h on Freebase; 2 h to transfer); only two Freebase datasets and one transfer set tested.
Faithfulness evidence is retrieval coverage and case studies; no human or automatic faithfulness metric.
Baselines are copied from other papers; LLM baselines are zero-shot; no seeds, variance or significance tests.
Table 3 has apparently swapped WebQSP columns for LLaMA2/Alpaca; WebQSP-only RoG F1 (61.8) is below UniKGQA.
